correct_alts:
The :payments:test task failed because the settlesLargeBatch test ran out of Java heap: the test JVM is capped at 512m and BatchBuffer.grow kept copying a bigger array.
Raising the test heap above 512m or shrinking the batch should fix it.
OutOfMemoryError in settlesLargeBatch (:payments:test) because the worker JVM only gets 512m. The buffer growth exhausted the heap, so Gradle marked the whole task as failed.
